I've narrowed our software engineer candidates down to three strong finalists after the technical screens. All three passed our coding assessment with scores above 85% and have relevant cloud infrastructure experience. Should we proceed with scheduling team interviews for next week, or do you want me to run an additional screening round first?

Starting to compile Q3 travel requests from department heads. I've received budget estimates from three teams so far, but I'm still waiting on Marketing and Sales to submit their itineraries. I'll send a follow-up to both departments today and aim to have the consolidated plan ready for review by Thursday.

Checking in on the supply room reorganization - I've finished inventorying the paper stock and found we're running low on letterhead (2 reams left). Should I place an order for the standard 10-ream case, or do you want to adjust quantities based on recent usage patterns?
Sent the job posting to three local universities and posted on two industry job boards. Will start reviewing applications as they come in and update the team on response rates by Friday.

Reviewed the vendor contract revisions from last week. The indemnification clause still needs tightening—current language leaves us exposed on third-party IP claims. I'll draft alternative language and circulate by tomorrow morning for team review.

Checking the supply closet and printer stations for any maintenance needs this week—so far the west wing copier is jamming frequently and the break room faucet has a slow drip. I'll put in a service request for the copier tomorrow morning; does anyone know if facilities has a preferred plumber for small repairs, or should I call the building management line?
